title: Retire unloved books
statementMd:
Delete books that have never been loaned, then report how many books remain.

Expected columns: `remaining`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: `DELETE ... WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
DELETE FROM books WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT book_id FROM loans); SELECT COUNT(*) AS remaining FROM books;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
